# sembast

**Tag**: nosql, database, mobile, security

## 简介

NoSQL persistent embedded file system document-based database for Dart VM and Flutter with encryption support.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/tekartik/sembast.dart/tree/master/sembast
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/sembast
